mathematical_content: An integral real has a monic integer annihilator of degree at least2, without irrationality. Its witness may be reducible and nonminimal: multiply a supplied monic annihilator by X^N. New verified arbitrary-cutoff wrapper works over nontrivial CommRing coefficients/Ring algebra, with a still broader CommSemiring/Semiring witness transformation. Nontrivial coefficient ring is necessary for unrestricted positive degree cutoffs, not nontrivial target, domain, characteristiczero, order or topology. This is existence/degree padding of an annihilator, not coefficient height, primitive factor descent, determinant or index estimation.

module_context_overrides.Roth/Main.lean: Main combines algebraic scalar reduction, finite approximations, polynomial witnesses, parameter selection and the final Taylor contradiction; a padded annihilator is one supplied-input step, not those other conclusions.
module_context_overrides.Roth/LeanEval.lean: LeanEval is the uniform Diophantine endpoint. Polynomial witness padding feeds its imported Roth proof but does not alone prove uniform rational error bounds.

Roth.exists_nat_mul_isIntegral.comparison: 268 normalizes an algebraic real to an integral real by positive natural scalar.272 takes an already integral element and chooses a monic annihilator with a requested degree bound. Both concern integrality, but scalar normalization and polynomial degree padding are different witnesses/operations, with no shared approximation or height conclusion.

Roth.reduction.comparison: 271 transfers infinite approximation pairs to an integral irrational center while losing exponent.272 constructs an annihilating polynomial for a supplied integral center and imposes no irrationality or approximation hypotheses. These are successive proof stages, not equivalent reductions.

Roth.exists_primitive_smul_eq.comparison: The primitive-representative theorem rescales arbitrary rational polynomial coefficients to primitive integer content.272 starts from integrality and produces a monic root polynomial padded by X^N. A coefficient scalar representative and a root-annihilator witness with degree floor are distinct; monicity is not an available normalization for arbitrary rational polynomials via arbitrary integer scalars.

Roth.exists_eq_pow_mul_of_rootMultiplici.comparison: The root-multiplicity theorem extracts the maximal power of a given linear root factor and a residual cofactor.272 appends X^N to an existing monic annihilator solely to raise degree, with no maximal multiplicity or cofactor-nonvanishing requirement. Sharing polynomial multiplication does not identify the statements.

Roth.norm_coeff_modByMonic_le.comparison: The remainder estimate assumes a supplied monic divisor and bounds reduced coefficients.272 constructs some monic annihilator with a lower-degree cutoff and no fixed coefficient-height control. Padding does not itself supply the quantitative remainder norm estimate.

Roth.main_lemma.comparison: 266 takes a supplied monic integer annihilator and derives a high-index auxiliary integer polynomial with rational nonvanishing/derivative-height bounds.272 supplies a possible annihilator with degree>=2 but no auxiliary-polynomial/index/height conclusion. The source and generic padding proof are elementary prerequisites, not the full quantitative Roth construction.
